run_gmock_leak_test: run the gmock_leak_test.py test suite to verify leaked mock object detection in Google Mock
test_catches_leaked_mock_by_default: test that Google Mock catches leaked mock objects by default when running ExpectCall or OnCall tests
test_does_not_catch_leaked_mock_when_dis: test that leaked mocks are ignored when the gmock_catch_leaked_mocks flag is set to 0
test_catches_leaked_mock_when_enabled: test that leaked mocks are caught when the gmock_catch_leaked_mocks flag is explicitly enabled
test_catches_multiple_leaked_mocks: test that Google Mock catches multiple leaked mock objects in a single test run
